title: Allen Dulles witnessing a saucer

tellings.quote: absolutely this stuff I've heard the same stuff about uh Dulles and the you know witnessing the saucer and checks the lock and so on and so forth.

plain: Allen Dulles, the head of the CIA in the 1950s, is said to have seen a flying saucer himself, in a story that also involves checking a lock. The philosopher and researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels he has "heard the same stuff" about Dulles, but he passes it on only in passing and gives no details. If true, it would mean a CIA director saw a saucer with his own eyes.
